description: Trigger evals for the skillsmith:start skill. 'expect' says whether a fresh Claude Code session should load Skillsmith for the query. Splits follow Anthropic's skill-creator advice: tune descriptions on train, report on test.

queries.q: I have an idea for an app that reminds people to water their plants. I can't code. Can you build it for me?
Build me a website where my yoga students can book classes and pay.
I'm a designer with a side-project idea for a habit tracker. I don't program. Help me build it end to end.
I want to launch a small SaaS that turns podcast episodes into blog posts. Where do we start?
Let's turn my idea for a recipe-sharing app into a real product I can launch.
I run a small book club and want a web app that picks our next book. I've never written code.
Fix the off-by-one error in this loop: for (let i = 0; i <= items.length; i++) { total += items[i]; }
What's the difference between let and const in JavaScript?
Explain how git rebase differs from git merge.
Convert this SQL to a Prisma query: SELECT * FROM users WHERE age > 30 ORDER BY name;
Summarize in one sentence: The meeting moved to Thursday because the room was booked.
